description:
## [1.0.3](https://github.com/andersonlucasg3/AppleMusic-DiLink/releases/tag/v1.0.3)

Fix startup crash reported on the BYD DiLink (Android 10): the `WindowInsetsControllerCompat` constructor (`x2.W$a`) no longer executes the `WindowInsetsController`-typed delegate on API < 30 — it initializes the impl/window fields directly, so no missing class is resolved on the legacy path. Also declares `apkFileType = XAPK` and the original APK signing fingerprints (1.0.2 feature).
